name: hivex
description: HIVEX beta: oficina virtual y gestión de empresa

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @hivex/server" "npm run dev -w @hivex/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hivex/server && npm run build -w @hivex/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @hivex/server && npm run lint -w @hivex/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @hivex/server && npm run typecheck -w @hivex/web
